name: Right in Two
source:
The story is based on the song "Right in Two" by Tool.
The story is basically about three angels contemplating humans and their existence.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=8574]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
